output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Ramp's latest disclosed valuation is $60 billion. The company announced that valuation on October 15, 2026, alongside a $1.85 billion primary financing round led by Dragoneer Investment Group.
caveats: Ramp is privately held, so $60 billion is the latest disclosed financing-round valuation rather than a continuously quoted public-market capitalization.
No later valuation announcement than October 15, 2026 was identified as of November 11, 2026.
